future_artifact_declarations.declarations: New tag `cv_heading_icon(value, location="page")` returns `HeadingIconPresentation(host_class, inline_html)`; define this frozen record in the tag module. New `CvHeadingNode.size`, `CvHeadingNode.icon_css` and `cv_heading size=N icon_class=expression`; `icon_class` adds the projected host classes independently of the existing `class` expression. New private `_heading_class(location, slot)` lookup in button_classes. Keys: `heading:size-1` … `heading:size-6`, `heading:icon-host`, `heading:icon-inline`, and optional `heading-page:icon-host`, `heading-modal:icon-host`, `heading-group:icon-host` plus corresponding `:icon-inline` keys. New test file `tests/test1/test_heading_icons.py`; all other paths modify existing files.

New `tests/test1/test_heading_docs.py` compiles published heading fences; new heading-site test cases in `test_heading_icons.py`. Test-only `data-test-page-title` marks the test host's title wrapper, never object-detail group wrappers. No additional public helper beyond plan 01's size/icon_class arguments and icon projection. The existing `cv_header` body block stays overridable; the legacy standalone icon-block placement is replaced in migrated examples.

New private module `lib/presentation.py`: frozen `GroupPresentation(group, control_id, panel_id, selected)`, `ComponentPresentation(id, tablist_id, content_id, groups)`, `_project_component(groups, component_id=None, scope=None)`, `_render_scope(context)` and `_validate_id_token(value, label)`. New `render_object_detail(..., component_id=None)` and `render_group(..., presentation=None, component=None)` keyword arguments; template fields `component`, `presentation`, retaining existing `groups`, `group`, `prop`, `layout`. New `data-cv-od-tabs` stock tablist marker. New test file `tests/test1/od/test_object_detail_identity.py`. Helper names are private; projected fields/tag kwargs are the intended theme surface.

New `PropertyGroupConfig.id: str | None`, `ResolvedGroup.id: str | None` appended with default None; `ObjectDetailMixin.cv_object_detail_id`, `cv_get_object_detail_id()` and template context `object_detail_id`. New private before-validator `validate_group_id` and render-scope test fixtures. No persisted model/database fields. Plan 03's `_validate_id_token`, `_project_component`, `_render_scope` are extended here.

New `tabs.js`, public `cv.initObjectDetailTabs(root=document)`, private `initObjectDetailTabs`, `disposeObjectDetailTabs`, one distinct global listener-install guard; new `CrudViewsObjectDetailConfig.ready` override; asset bundle key `crud_views_object_detail`, static path `crud_views_object_detail/js/tabs.js`. New `tests/js/object-detail-tabs.test.js` and `tests/test1/od/test_presentation_assets.py`. Existing data-cv-od-tabs from plan 03 identifies owned roots.

Extend existing test-only `loadScript(name, packageName="crud_views")` with an explicit core/object-detail static-root map. Existing one-argument callers, async behavior, navigation proxy and setup imports remain compatible. The runtime-contract sandbox copies both static JS directories and must execute the new ordinary test without Python. Task 05-01 owns loader plus real-asset tracer (five files); task 05-02 owns sandbox inclusion plus modal lifecycle (three files). The additional 3,000 raw tokens cover these harness changes and their verification; calibration factor 1, zero samples, confidence low yields 21,000 tokens, with no extra task or wave.

Append `ResolvedProperty.badge_color: str | None = None` and `badge_pill: bool = False`. New private `_resolve_badge(value, badge)` result carries color/pill/css; retain `_resolve_badge_css` as an internal delegating helper only if current tests/callers require it, without a second resolution in resolve_property. New `tests/test1/od/test_badge_semantics.py` and `tests/test1/test_badge_docs.py`. No new badge configuration keys.

New `CardAction.reject_removed_no_label` model-before validator; no replacement alias. Existing files gain negative-input and unknown-extra-preservation cases. No new file is required. Purposeful old-spelling negative tests and migration examples remain.

New `tests/browser/presentation.cjs`, `tests/browser/presentation_server.py`, `tests/browser/presentation-config.test.cjs`, `tests/browser/templates/presentation/stock.html`, `tests/browser/templates/presentation/native.html`. Runner CLI `--case tabs|all`, `--output PATH`; environment `CV_PRESENTATION_PORT` (unset defaults to 8145; explicitly supplied values must be decimal integers 1024..65535 excluding reserved modal-focus/conditional-formsets ports 8143/8144), reusing explicit `CV_FOCUS_PYTHON`, `CV_FOCUS_NODE`, `CV_FOCUS_PLAYWRIGHT`, `CV_FOCUS_CHROMIUM` overrides. New `tests/test1/test_presentation_migration_docs.py` with fence extraction/render cases; new `06.5-PUBLIC-SURFACE.md` in this phase directory. Update existing `06.5-VALIDATION.md` only with actual execution outcomes. Published fields are those enumerated in plans 01/03/04/05/06; test helpers remain private and Phase 7 owns final stability classification.

For A9, use gettext_lazy("January") and gettext_lazy("February") as real translated group titles with stable explicit group IDs. Exercise host and element icon libraries across page/modal/group headings with the preflight-verified Font Awesome CSS/font, visible title/accessibility names, no duplicates, disabled/empty icons and theme sizing replacement/removal. Add a minimal native noninteractive detail layout and semantic badge via context-isolated test loader, with no Bootstrap assets or markup dependencies; assert escaped titles/values, original group/prop/value/od_settings and arbitrary semantic color/pill mapping. Record exact versions, source hashes, required-asset provenance, console/page errors, actual assertion results and explicit untested screen-reader/non-Bootstrap visual areas in the report. Do not infer AT certification from DOM assertions.</action>

Research A1/A2 adopted. Shared defaults: size-N = hN, icon-host = {name_class}, icon-inline = me-2. These eight keys and the empty-string heading-page:icon-inline and heading-modal:icon-inline defaults join DEFAULT_BUTTON_CLASSES; all other optional location overrides remain absent, never prefilled with None. Project/theme shared values still win over these builtin location values because layers precede specificity. Icon spacing is owned by configurable slots; preserve structural/title classes at consumers and document intentional group icon-style changes. Spec-less edges PRES-01 adjacency/empty/ordering are resolved explicitly by the truths above. Task 01-02 exclusively owns the heading registry/test/canonical-count update in buttons.md; plan 07 follows this plan before editing that document's alias prose. Baseline source has 74 keys and five default host slots; derive and assert the resulting counts from the complete intended key set at execution rather than copying an unmeasured total.
